findings.evidence: The patch only guards textViewDidChangeSelection with isUpdatingView. publishAtBottom writes the SwiftUI binding parent.isAtScrollBottom synchronously and has no isUpdatingView guard. The captured LLDB stack in the task proves only the textViewDidChangeSelection → inputCaret path; the scroll path was not part of the captured evidence.
findings.requirement: 同流程前后对照：输入、发送、流式更新与列表无警告及重复/丢失/回退 (no illegal synchronous SwiftUI state publication during the send flow)
findings.trigger: Inside updateUIView, tv.text = text and (in the overflow branch) tv.layoutIfNeeded() can change the UITextView scroll content/offset; if UIKit delivers scrollViewDidScroll synchronously while isUpdatingView == true, publishAtBottom writes parent.isAtScrollBottom synchronously during the view update.
findings.verification: Static inspection only; the app was not executed during this review. The task reports 0 target warnings in the send interval, but the startup-phase same-text warnings were left unverified and the composer-overflow/paste-while-updating path (which calls layoutIfNeeded inside updateUIView) was not specifically exercised.
